# hubkit

> hubkit is a session supervisor for Claude Code: hooks and a CLI that keep the one hub session coordinating other sessions honest. It gives each order a clock and an evidence check, tracks requests and routed work, blocks a premature "done", and learns from the user's corrections. Read verbs take --json; exit codes are 0 ok, 2 bad usage, 3 refused, 4 not found; every error ends with a NEXT line.
